## [S6] Offline validation gates

在写完完整 bring-up 前，构建链必须按顺序通过下列纯离线门槛；任何 synthetic
fixture 绝不烧录：

1. **Vendor no-change reconstruction**：以同一 profile 的厂商 Bootloader、CP
   `app.bin`、AP `app1.bin` 和分区输入复包。输出必须逐字节匹配已验证恢复包，
   即 SHA-256 等于 S5 的基线。
2. **Independent decode verification**：独立于包装实现，逐块重算全部代码分区
   的 CRC16、去掉 CRC 字节并与各 raw 输入逐字节比较；还要检查分区范围、填充
   和超限拒绝行为。比较只覆盖 manifest 记录的 raw length；末个 CRC block 的
   `0xff` payload padding、section 间的 physical padding 和 packer 的额外末尾
   padding 都不得被误认为 raw `app.bin`、raw `app1.bin` 或 raw Bootloader。
3. **Synthetic component replacement**：先使用带已知 MSP、Thumb reset word 与可识别内容
   的小 raw CP fixture 替换 CP 输入。验证 raw `[0x00..0x1f]` 位于完整包 physical
   `[0x11000..0x1101f]`，CRC 位于 `[0x11020..0x11021]`，下一 payload 位于
   `[0x11022..0x11041]`；再以识别性 AP fixture 验证其位于 AP physical slot。
   每次只替换一个 component 时，另一个 component 与 Bootloader 解包后必须保持不变。
4. **Real component static image validation**：在各自链接脚本和最小启动代码能产生 ELF 后，
   使用真实 `nuttx.bin` 替换 fixture。检查 `.vectors`/`_vectors` 位于
   `0x02010000`，word 0 位于批准的 CPU0 SRAM，word 1 是 CP XIP 范围内的 Thumb
   地址，`.data` load address 在 CP XIP 范围内，`.data`/`.bss` run address 位于
   批准 SRAM，且两个容量限制都满足。AP component 按其独立合同检查向量、
   reset path、RAM 和容量；不能使用 CP 规则替代。

NuttX ARM-M 的 reset vector 可以指向公共 `start()` 包装函数，再由它进入
chip-specific `__start()`；验证器不得错误要求 word 1 恒等于 `__start | 1`。

上述门槛仅证明镜像构建、分区与静态链接正确。只有后续人工执行完整包烧录并
取得冷启动/复位 UART 证据，才能证明 Bootloader handoff、CPU0 启动和 NSH。

## [S7] Component evolution and launch boundary

`configs/cp/` 和 `configs/ap/` 始终是独立 component config。L0 profile 的厂商
`app1.bin` 可在 AP component 已独立链接、静态验证和真机验证后，替换为
OpenVela `app1.bin`；合包脚本、完整包文件名和 CP 主入口关系保持不变。CP 与 AP
不能合并为一个 ELF、一张向量表或一份 RAM 链接布局。

在 AP 接管前，OpenVela CP 不得调用厂商的 `start_cpu1_core()`、CPU2 reset、
Mailbox 或 SMP 路径。保留厂商 `app1.bin` 不构成 AP 支持或 AP 启动验收。AP
component 的启动、CPU1/CPU2 分工、SMP 策略与 CP-to-AP handoff 必须另行冻结，
并由 CP 的受控启动路径在真机验证后才可启用。

## [S8] Out of scope

- 重写、替换或反向工程厂商 Bootloader。
- NuttX OTA、OTA `.rbl`、OTA zip、OTA slot 更新和任何远程升级服务。
- 自动烧录、批量烧录，或 Efuse/OTP/SecureBoot/设备身份操作。
- 将厂商二进制、密钥、SDK 源码或生成文件复制进团队仓。
- 在 CPU0 最小 NSH 通过之前实现 AP 启动、AP NuttX payload、SMP、Mailbox、
  Wi-Fi/BLE、USB、显示或 DeskMate；创建 AP config 的目录/合同不等于启用 AP。
- 仅凭离线验证、host 构建或 mock 声称硬件启动完成。

结论：**标准移植流程的大方向已经落进文档了，但尚未形成“从源码到可烧录包”的可执行 BSP。**目前我们完成的是“架构、证据、封包合同和路线设计”；真正的芯片层、板级层、构建接入和离线打包器都还没有实现。

尤其要把通用流程改写成 BK7258 的实际链路：

```text
NuttX ARMv8-M 公共层
  → BK7258 CP 芯片层
  → BK7258 DevKit 板级层
  → CP raw app.bin
  → Beken Bootloader metadata + CRC 线性封包
  → all-app.bin
  → bk_loader -s 0
  → UART early marker
  → nx_start()
  → nsh>
```

这比普通 MCU 多出了一层关键步骤：

```text
nuttx.bin 不能直接烧录
nuttx.bin → app.bin → Beken linear-CRC all-app.bin → 烧录
```

## 已经落入文档的部分

|---|---|---|
| ARMv8-M 公共架构复用 | 已确定 | 复用 NuttX `arch/arm` 的 ARM-M/ARMv8-M 公共路径，不新造 CPU 架构 |
| CP CPU0 非 SMP 边界 | 已确定 | L0 只运行 CPU0；不主动启动 CPU1/CPU2、不启用 Mailbox/SMP |
| 启动顺序 | 已设计 | `Bootloader handoff → vector/stack → .data/.bss → clock → early UART → heap → nx_start()` |
| 向量表与 Flash 映射 | 已设计 | CP `.vectors` 的候选执行地址是 `0x02010000`，不是物理 offset `0x11000` |
| `.data` / `.bss` / heap 职责 | 已设计 | 已明确 linker script 必须提供的区段和符号 |
| 早期 UART 原则 | 已设计 | UART0、GPIO11 TX、轮询发送、先输出 marker，再做完整 console |
| 板级职责 | 已设计 | pinmux、console 策略、LED/按键/I2C/SPI 归板级；控制器/IRQ/timer 归芯片层 |

## 当前还没有落地的代码

现在工作树中的 `chips/bk7258/` 和 `board/bk7258-devkit/` 仍是纯骨架：

```text
已有
├── Kconfig / CMake / Make.defs 占位文件
├── board_boot.c 空实现
├── configs/nsh/defconfig 占位配置
├── CPU0 合同与镜像规范
└── manifest linkfile 映射

尚未有
├── 可选的 CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_BK7258 选择链
├── configs/cp/defconfig
├── configs/ap/defconfig
├── BK7258 寄存器头与 IRQ 定义
├── flash.ld
├── bk7258_start.c
├── bk7258_allocateheap.c
├── bk7258_irq.c
├── bk7258_timer.c
├── bk7258_lowputc.c
├── bk7258_uart.c

├── Beken 包装器与独立 decoder
└── 原厂无变化复包测试
```

因此，现在还没有可以工作的命令：

```bash
./build.sh board/bk7258-devkit/configs/cp --cmake -j8
```

因为 `configs/cp` 不存在，BK7258 也没有接入 NuttX 的 chip 选择链、链接脚本或启动代码。

## 标准流程中要校正的地方

你给出的通用流程基本正确，但对 BK7258/NuttX 要做四处重要修正。

1. **不是把所有芯片代码直接写进团队仓的 `arch/arm/src/bk7258/`。**

   标准 NuttX 的确通常是：

   ```text
   nuttx/arch/arm/src/<chip>/
   nuttx/boards/arm/<chip>/<board>/
   ```

   但本项目已有所有权约束：团队仓维护 `chips/bk7258/` 与 `board/bk7258-devkit/`，通过 manifest 映射进 `vendor/beken/...`；若 NuttX 公共架构层确实需要改动，必须准备独立上游 PR，不能直接把上游 `nuttx/` 当团队代码修改。

2. **不用重写 ARM-M 通用的调度/上下文切换。**

   `up_initialize()` 已在 NuttX ARM 公共层实现；`up_switch_context()`、异常入口、基础向量机制也是架构公共能力。BK7258 应实现的是 SoC 对接：

   ```text
   BK7258 reset/start
   BK7258 clock/reset gates
   BK7258 ICU/NVIC IRQ routing
   BK7258 timer → arch_alarm
   BK7258 UART/GPIO/pinmux
   BK7258 memory/heap boundaries
   ```

   而不是重写 ARM 的调度原语。

3. **链接地址不能只“按 Datasheet memory map”填写。**

   Datasheet 只说明 XIP、640 KB shared SRAM、16 KB ITCM/DTCM、TrustZone 等硬件能力；它不定义 CP 可用 SRAM 的实际区间、CPU 可见 XIP 窗口、Bootloader handoff、VTOR 初值或安全域。BK7258 的 `flash.ld` 必须结合锁定 profile、SDK 产物和真机试验冻结。

4. **完整包封装不是 board CMake 的普通 `objcopy` 后处理。**

   对 BK7258，`nuttx.bin → app.bin` 只是 component export；真正 `all-app.bin` 必须经过 Bootloader staging、CRC 展开、分区线性写入和独立 decode 验证。

## 从当前状态到首次可烧录 CP 包，缺什么

### A. 可立即开始，完全离线

这是我们当前应进入的下一阶段。

```text
T34.1
  占位 nsh 配置
    → configs/cp
    → 未来 configs/ap
    → 本地外部输入 CMake 模板

T34.2
  固定 bk7258-devkit-l0-vendor-ap profile
    → 锁定外部输入、SHA-256、raw length、Flash SKU/revision
    → 锁定 Bootloader staging 与 linear-CRC 模式

T34.3
  package_bk7258.py + 独立 decoder
    → 不调用 ota_pack/post_package
    → 只生成 all-app.bin + manifest

T34.4
  原厂无变化复包
    → SHA-256 必须等于已验证恢复包
    → synthetic CP/AP 替换验证
```

这四项完成后，才能说“我们的封包链正确”；还不能说 NuttX 能启动。

### B. CPU0 真实 BSP 前的硬件参数冻结

以下仍是 `flash.ld`、`__start()` 和 early UART 的阻塞项：

```text
1. CPU0 可独占 SRAM 的绝对地址、长度和 heap/stack 边界
2. secure / non-secure 外设地址域
3. Bootloader 是否已配置 VTOR；NuttX 是否必须显式重设
4. FPU/ABI 决策
   - Datasheet：Armv8-M STAR-MC1、双精度 FPU
   - SDK：cortex-m33 + fpv5-sp-d16 + hard-float + mcmse
   - 不能直接用任意一方替代实际确认
5. UART0 clock gate、reset gate、pinmux 的寄存器与安全域
6. 可独占的 arch_alarm timer、时钟源、ICU/NVIC 路由、清中断语义
7. 板卡实际 SKU、Flash 容量与当前 8 MB 分区 profile 是否匹配
```

Datasheet 能确认 UART 下载、SWD、GPIO10/11 的下载复用、XIP、QSPI、六个 timer、640 KB shared SRAM 等能力；但不能确认上面这些具体 BSP 参数。

### C. CP 最小启动实现

硬件参数冻结后才开始写：

```text
chips/bk7258/
├── include/bk7258_memorymap.h
├── include/bk7258_irq.h
├── bk7258_start.c
├── bk7258_allocateheap.c
├── bk7258_irq.c
├── bk7258_timer.c
├── bk7258_lowputc.c
├── bk7258_uart.c
└── CMakeLists.txt / Make.defs / Kconfig

board/bk7258-devkit/
├── include/board.h
├── scripts/flash.ld
├── src/bk7258_boardinitialize.c
├── src/bk7258_bringup.c
├── configs/cp/defconfig
└── CMakeLists.txt
```

实现顺序必须是：

```text
链接 + 向量表
  → __start 中 .data/.bss
  → VTOR 与初始异常状态
  → UART0 polling marker
  → heap
  → IRQ / timer
  → nx_start()
  → serial console
  → nsh>
```

第一个硬件里程碑不是 `nsh>`，而是：

```text
复位后稳定输出一个 early UART marker
```

有这个标记才可以区分“Bootloader 没跳转”“链接/启动异常”“UART 未初始化”“NuttX 后期问题”。

### D. 当前 L0 完整包与首次烧录

CP 可构建后：

```text
OpenVela CP app.bin
+ locked vendor app1.bin
+ staged vendor Bootloader
→ all-app.bin
→ 静态 ELF/vector/size/CRC 检查
→ 人工 bk_loader 烧录
→ UART marker
→ nsh>
```

首次真机验收要记录：

```text
CP ELF/raw app SHA-256
all-app.bin SHA-256
profile / SDK commit / input SHA-256
板卡 revision / SKU / Flash 容量
烧录命令与 bk_loader 版本
冷启动与复位 UART 原始日志
help / uname / ps 输出
原厂恢复镜像的恢复记录
```

## 完整阶段图

```text
已完成：证据与设计
  ├── CPU0/CP L0 方向
  ├── component image 模型
  ├── Beken CRC / Bootloader staging 合同
  └── 原厂恢复基线
          │
当前：离线封包链
  ├── 锁定 profile
  ├── 专用 wrapper + decoder
  ├── 原厂无变化复包
  └── synthetic CP/AP 替换测试
          │
下一：CP BSP
  ├── memory/security/timer/UART 参数冻结
  ├── configs/cp + linker + startup
  ├── early UART marker
  └── nx_start / NSH
          │
随后：当前 L0 真机
  └── OpenVela CP + vendor AP → all-app.bin → CP NSH
          │
后续：基础外设
  └── UART RX/IRQ、timer、LED、按键、I2C、SPI
          │
最后：OpenVela AP
  ├── configs/ap + app1.bin
  ├── CP→AP handoff
  └── OpenVela CP + OpenVela AP → all-app.bin
```

所以最准确的当前定位是：

> **我们已经完成“如何正确生成和验证 BK7258 完整镜像”的设计，正准备进入“锁定 profile 与离线复包验证”；尚未进入真正的 CPU0 BSP 编码。**

下一项应是 `T34.1`，紧接 `T34.2`：先建立 `configs/cp` / `configs/ap` 组件边界和本地外部输入模板，再把当前 `beken_genie` profile 的实际 SHA-256、长度、SKU/Flash 容量写死。完成后才写包装器。

先厘清："打包"在 bringup 语境下有三层
| 层次 | 产物 | 什么时候需要 |
|------|------|-------------|
| **L1 编译产物** | `nuttx.bin` / `.elf` / `.hex` / `.map` | bringup 当天，JTAG/串口烧录 |
| **L2 烧录镜像** | 多核合并镜像 + 分区表 + header | 首次整板烧录、产线烧录 |
| **L3 OTA 包** | 签名镜像 + A/B 槽 + 版本号 + manifest | 量产后的空中升级 |

bringup 阶段卡在 L1 就能继续调；但要交付到产线或支持 OTA，必须做到 L2/L3。
L1：编译产物（NuttX 默认就给你）
make 完成后，nuttx/ 目录下直接产出：
nuttx.bin      # 裸二进制，最常用，直接 OpenOCD/JLink 烧
nuttx.elf      # 带 debug 符号，GDB 调试用
nuttx.hex      # Intel HEX 格式，部分烧录器需要
nuttx.map      # 内存布局，查 code size 用

bringup 阶段只需要：
# OpenOCD 烧裸 bin
openocd -f interface/jlink.cfg -f target/<chip>.cfg \
        -c "init; reset halt; flash write_image nuttx.bin 0x08000000; reset run; shutdown"

# 或 JLink
JLinkExe -device <chip> -if SWD -speed 4000 -autoconnect 1 \
         -CommanderScript flash.txt

这一步不需要任何打包工具——nuttx.bin 直接烧。bringup 90% 的调试都在这个层面。
多核 SoC：各核独立编译
nuttx_ap.bin      # AP 核固件
nuttx_cp.bin      # CP 核固件
nuttx_sensor.bin  # Sensor 核固件
nuttx_audio.bin   # Audio 核固件

每个核有自己的 defconfig，各自 make，烧到各自分区。bringup 时可以只先调 AP 核，其他核先空着或用原厂固件。

在板级代码里定义 Flash 布局：
/* boards/<vendor>/<board>/src/partition_table.c */
static const struct partition_entry_s g_partition_table[] =
{
  /* name          offset      size        flags            */
  { "mcuboot",    0x00000000, 0x00020000, PART_FLAG_BOOT   },
  { "ap_slota",   0x00020000, 0x00100000, PART_FLAG_IMAGE  },
  { "ap_slotb",   0x00120000, 0x00100000, PART_FLAG_IMAGE  },
  { "cp_image",   0x00220000, 0x00080000, PART_FLAG_IMAGE  },
  { "sensor_img", 0x002A0000, 0x00040000, PART_FLAG_IMAGE  },
  { "audio_img",  0x002E0000, 0x00060000, PART_FLAG_IMAGE  },
  { "littlefs",   0x00340000, 0x00080000, PART_FLAG_FS     },
  { "nvs",        0x003F0000, 0x00008000, PART_FLAG_CONFIG },
};

约束：A/B 槽大小必须相同；NVS 存 boot flag；LittleFS 分区 OTA 不擦。

pack_image --partition partition_table.c \
           --mcuboot mcuboot.bin \
           --ap nuttx_ap.bin \
           --cp nuttx_cp.bin \
           --sensor nuttx_sensor.bin \
           --audio nuttx_audio.bin \
           --output factory_image.bin

产线用这个 factory_image.bin 一次性烧满整片 Flash。
BES SoC 特殊情况
BES 芯片有 NOR + eMMC 双介质：
NOR Flash：放 bootloader + AP 固件（小、快、可执行）
eMMC：放 CP/Sensor/Audio 固件 + 资源 + 音频（大、慢）
打包时分别生成 NOR 镜像和 eMMC 镜像，用 dldtool 分别烧。参考 device-p62 / device-q61 skill。
L3：OTA 包打包（量产分发）
L3 在 L2 基础上加签名 + 版本 + A/B 槽管理。
流程
1. 各核编译 → nuttx_<core>.bin
2. imgtool 签名（每核独立签名）
3. ota_pack_tool 合并 + 加 manifest（版本号、依赖关系）
4. 生成 ota_package.bin
5. 分发到手机 App / OTA 服务器
签名（MCUBoot imgtool）
imgtool sign --key signing_key.pem \
             --align 4 --version 1.2.0 \
             --header-size 0x200 --slot-size 0x100000 \
             nuttx_ap.bin nuttx_ap_signed.bin

关键点：
--slot-size 必须和分区表对应槽大小一致
--version 用于防降级（新版本必须 ≥ 当前）
每核独立签名，MCUBoot 分别验
合并为 OTA 包
ota_pack_tool --ap nuttx_ap_signed.bin \
              --cp nuttx_cp_signed.bin \
              --sensor nuttx_sensor_signed.bin \
              --audio nuttx_audio_signed.bin \
              --output ota_package.bin --version 1.2.0
必要的 Kconfig
# Bootloader 侧
CONFIG_MCUBOOT=y
CONFIG_MCUBOOT_SIGNATURE_TYPE_RSA=y
CONFIG_MCUBOOT_SIGNATURE_KEY_FILE="signing_key.pem"
CONFIG_MCUBOOT_SWAP_USING_MOVE=y
CONFIG_MCUBOOT_DOWNGRADE_PREVENTION=y
# AP 核 OTA 服务
CONFIG_SYSTEM_OTA=y
CONFIG_SYSTEM_OTA_MCUBOOT=y
引导 + 回滚
MCUBoot 读取 NVS boot flag
  NONE     → 启动 Slot A
  TEST     → 启动 Slot B（新固件待验证）
              成功 → app 调 confirm() → CONFIRMED
              失败 → 看门狗复位 → 回滚 Slot A
  CONFIRMED → 启动 Slot B（已确认）

新固件首次启动必须调 ota_confirm()，否则看门狗超时自动回滚。这是防变砖的核心机制。
Bringup 各阶段的打包需求
| 阶段 | 打包层级 | 产物 | 工具 |
|------|---------|------|------|
| 单核 NSH 跑通 | L1 | `nuttx.bin` | `make` 直接出 |

| 量产 OTA | L3 | `ota_package.bin` | imgtool + ota_pack_tool |

### Approved CPU0 replacement and vendor-component reuse boundary

The initial NuttX bring-up adopts this composition model:

```text
physical Flash 0x00000000
├── vendor BootROM                         (chip-resident; unchanged)
├── vendor normal Bootloader               (preserved and repackaged)
├── CP application partition / app.bin
│   └── replace with the independently built NuttX CPU0 image
└── AP application partition / app1.bin
    └── preserve the known-good vendor AP image during CPU0 L0 bring-up
```

This follows the vendor packaging model observed in the successful
`beken_genie` build:

- `bk7258` is classified as the CP application and copied as `app.bin`.
- `bk7258_ap` is classified as the AP application and copied as `app1.bin`.
- the project packer supplies the bootloader, CP image and AP image to the
  CRC-aware linear packer at their partition offsets.

In architecture terms, `app.bin` is the CP/CPU0 image replacement target and
`app1.bin` is the application-domain image intended for AP CPU1/CPU2 work.
For the specific captured `beken_genie` build, static inspection confirms AP
CPU0 and CPU1 startup objects, but does not show a linked CPU2 startup object.
Therefore the preserved `app1.bin` must be called a known-good vendor AP image,
not evidence that every AP core has started in every firmware configuration.

The complete image must be produced by the vendor packaging chain (or an
independently verified compatible implementation), not by concatenating files:

```text
raw NuttX CPU0 app.bin
  + preserved vendor app1.bin
  + vendor normal Bootloader
  + generated partition metadata
  → per-partition 32-byte data + 2-byte CRC16 transformation
  → physical-offset linear package
  → complete image for bk_loader download -s 0
```

The raw normal Bootloader binary is not copied verbatim into the final package:
the native pack flow appends generated partition/OTA metadata before the
CRC-aware final image step. In the verified vendor build, the source
Bootloader is 52352 bytes and the pre-packaged temporary Bootloader is 52608
bytes. Do not use `cat`, do not substitute only `app.bin` at offset `0x11000`,
and do not hand-copy a raw Bootloader plus NuttX image.

```text
├── 厂商 Bootloader              保留，由厂商打包链处理分区元数据
├── CP app.bin                   替换为独立构建的 NuttX CPU0 镜像
└── AP app1.bin                  初期保留为已验证的厂商 AP 镜像
```

此处“保留 `app1.bin`”只表示将它继续放在完整 Flash 包中，以维持已验证的分区布局和恢复能力；NuttX CPU0 不调用 Mailbox、CPU1/CPU2 启动或 AP 应用路径，因此 AP 镜像的存在不改变 CPU0 单核 L0 范围。

完整镜像必须使用 Beken 分区与 CRC 打包链生成，不能使用 `cat` 或手工按 `0x11000` 写入 NuttX 原始 bin。已确认的原厂格式规则是每 32 字节原始应用数据追加 2 字节 CRC16（多项式 `0x8005`），并在链接/打包时区分物理 Flash 偏移、CRC 填充数据与 CPU 可执行 Flash 映射地址。NuttX CPU0 原始镜像、原厂 Bootloader 与原厂 `app1.bin` 需要交给该链路或经字节级验证的兼容实现生成新的完整包。

原厂完整包是恢复基线：`all-app.bin` 已在该 DevKit 通过 `/dev/ttyUSB0` 与 Linux `bk_loader` 2.1.11.8 成功烧录、CRC 校验、重启并输出原生运行日志。未来每次 NuttX 实验前必须记录输入/输出 SHA-256、分区 JSON、打包器版本/commit 与精确烧录命令，并保留这个恢复包。

### 统一证据包

5. 接线图/测试夹具说明、外设实例和 pinmux 配置；凭据、密钥与企业内容必须脱敏。
6. 失败时的复现步骤、错误码、HardFault/栈转储、符号解析结果和恢复方法。

### 分阶段测试策略

- L0 冒烟：冷启动、热复位、`help`、`uname`、`ps`；至少重复若干次并记录次数与结果。

text:
你的 L1/L2/L3 分层是对的，但 BK7258 需要做一个关键调整：

```text
普通 MCU：
L1 raw bin ──可直接写入 Flash──→ 启动调试
L2 合并镜像 ──→ 整板/产线
L3 OTA 包 ──→ 量产升级

BK7258 当前 profile：
L1 raw app.bin ──不能直接写 CP physical Flash──→ 仅静态检查 / 打包输入
L2 all-app.bin ──→ 首次 Flash 冷启动、日常真机 bring-up、整板烧录
L3 OTA 包 ──→ 当前明确不做
```

原因是已锁定的 Beken CP 分区不是连续 raw Flash：

```text
raw app.bin:
  [payload 32 B][payload 32 B][payload 32 B]...

CP physical Flash:
  [payload 32 B][CRC16 2 B][payload 32 B][CRC16 2 B]...
```

所以通用流程里的这类命令对 BK7258 当前 profile 不成立：

```bash
flash write_image nuttx.bin <CP physical flash offset>
```

它会把 raw bytes 连续写入物理 Flash，缺失 CRC 槽位；XIP 的 logical 地址映射和取指都会错。对本板首个可从 Flash 冷启动的 OpenVela CP 镜像，必须先经过 Beken linear-CRC 包装。

## 现有文档与 L1/L2/L3 的对应关系

| 你的层次 | BK7258 对应产物 | 当前文档状态 | 结论 |
|---|---|---|---|
| L1：CP 编译产物 | `nuttx`、`nuttx.bin`、`nuttx.map`、`bk7258/app.bin` | 已在组件规范 S2/S5 定义 | 需要实现 |
| L1：AP 编译产物 | 未来 `app1.bin`、AP ELF/map | 已定义为独立 AP component | 后置，当前不实现 |
| L2：可启动整板镜像 | `all-app.bin` | 已完整定义：Bootloader + CP + AP + CRC | 当前真机 bring-up 必需 |
| L3：OTA/签名/A/B | `.rbl`、OTA zip、版本、回滚 | 已明确排除 | 当前不需要 |

现有规范的正确部分是：

```text
L1 CP raw app.bin
  → 作为可检查、可反汇编、可封包的组件产物

L2 all-app.bin
  → 作为唯一正式、完整、可经 bk_loader 从 physical offset 0 烧录的镜像
```

这里的 `all-app.bin` 不应被理解为“量产以后才做的 factory image”。对 BK7258 当前 bring-up，它应称为：

> **开发阶段的完整可启动 Flash 镜像**

它既用于首次整板启动，也用于每次 CP Flash boot 验证；只是暂不包含 L3 的签名、OTA、A/B 槽或发布版本管理。

## 当前文档已经具备什么

现有组件镜像规范已经覆盖了 BK7258 最关键的 L2 约束：

- CP 和 AP 作为两个独立 component build，而不是合并 ELF；
- 当前 L0：OpenVela CP `app.bin` + 锁定厂商 `app1.bin`；
- raw CP `app.bin` 的 CPU XIP/vector 地址是 `0x02010000`；
- physical CP 分区起点是 `0x11000`，但不能用于 linker `ORIGIN`；
- 每 32 B payload 插入 2 B CRC16-BE；
- Bootloader 先做 `0x00` 对齐，再追加 `bk_ota_partitions.json` 序列化表，最后整体 CRC 编码；
- `all-app.bin` 是 linear-CRC physical-flash image，不允许混入 BKDLV10、BL1/BL2、MCUboot 或 OTA 包路径；
- 标准 SDK 的 `post_package()` / `ota_pack()` 不可直接复用；
- raw length 必须保留，不能把 `0xff` CRC padding 或包尾 padding 当成原始镜像；
- 原厂无变化复包必须逐字节匹配已验证的 `all-app.bin`；
- L3 OTA、A/B、签名、MCUboot、密钥管理均不在范围内。

因此，**L2 设计层基本是完整的，差的是实现和验证，不是方向。**

## 与通用流程相比，当前缺的是什么

### 1. 缺一个显式的 L1 调试路径说明

当前文档定义了 L1 编译产物，但没有把其用途分成两种：

```text
L1-A：静态调试
  ELF / map / raw app.bin
  → readelf、objdump、nm、向量表、段地址、容量检查
  → 当前确定可做

L1-B：SWD/JTAG RAM 调试
  ELF 下载到 SRAM，暂停/单步/看寄存器
  → 理论上可能有价值
  → 当前没有确认可用的调试器、接线、debug unlock、
    secure state、GDB server 或 RAM-load 流程
```

Datasheet 只确认芯片有 SWD，开发板原理图确认 P20/P21 是 SWCLK/SWDIO；但我们没有验证：

- 使用哪种 SWD probe；
- 是否需要特定 reset/boot mode；
- 当前 eFuse/安全域是否限制调试；
- 是否能通过 GDB 将 ELF load 到 SRAM；
- SRAM load 后如何设 VTOR、MSP、PC；
- 该模式是否影响或绕过 CP/AP 复位策略。

所以它应作为一个可选的 **D0 调试通道** 写入规划，而不是当前 bring-up 的必经路径。

其定位必须严格是：

```text
SWD RAM-load 成功
  = 可调试 __start / 时钟 / UART 的辅助能力

SWD RAM-load 成功
  ≠ 验证 Bootloader handoff
  ≠ 验证 Beken CRC/XIP 映射
  ≠ 验证 Flash cold boot
  ≠ 验证 all-app.bin
```

### 2. 缺“L2 开发镜像”和“L2 发布/产线镜像”的术语区分

当前 `all-app.bin` 是正确产物，但建议后续命名上区分：

```text
L2-dev:
  all-app.bin
 目标：开发板 Flash boot、冷启动/复位、CP NSH
  当前必须实现

L2-release:
 未来可增加 release manifest、版本号、产线校验
 但仍不等于 L3 OTA

L3:
  OTA 签名、A/B、版本、回滚、密钥
  当前明确不做
```

这避免把“完整 Flash 包”错误等同于“量产 OTA 签名包”。

### 3. 缺板卡/SKU/Flash 容量的实际锁定

Datasheet 明确 BK7258 有 4 MB 与 8 MB SKU。当前 `beken_genie` profile 的分区表用到：

```text
0x00000 .. 0x00800000
```

即按 8 MB Flash profile 工作。实施 T2 前必须补齐：

```text
实际板卡 SKU / 芯片丝印
Flash 总容量读取或可靠 BOM 证据
board revision
确认它能使用当前 8 MB beken_genie profile
```

否则即使 CRC、Bootloader metadata 都正确，也可能把 8 MB 分区表用到 4 MB 器件上。

### 4. 缺 CPU0 BSP 的硬件参数冻结

这属于通用流程的芯片层，但当前尚未允许编码：

```text
CPU0 可独占 SRAM 的绝对起点、长度
secure / non-secure 外设地址域
FPU / hard-float / CMSE 决策
VTOR 是否由 Bootloader 已设置、NuttX 是否要重设
UART0 clock gate、reset gate、pinmux 的最终寄存器序列
可独占 arch_alarm timer
Timer → ICU → NVIC 的实际路由、优先级、清中断方式
```

没有这些，不该写实际 `flash.ld`、`bk7258_start.c`、`bk7258_lowputc.c` 或 timer 驱动。

## 哪些内容在当前 BK7258 不需要

你的通用流程里，以下内容现在不应引入：

| 通用内容 | BK7258 当前决策 |
|---|---|
| `MCUBoot` | 不引入 |
| A/B slot | 不引入 |
| OTA manifest / OTA zip / `.rbl` | 不生成 |
| OTA version / rollback / `ota_confirm()` | 不实现 |
| 签名私钥与 HSM/CI 密钥流程 | 不需要 |
| 在板级 C 中重定义整套 partition table | 不做；当前以锁定 vendor profile 的 JSON/metadata 为源 |
| `nuttx.bin` 直接按 CP physical offset 烧录 | 明确禁止 |
| 自动烧录 | 明确禁止 |
| 自动 chip erase / Efuse / OTP / SecureBoot 操作 | 明确禁止 |
| 现在实现 AP NuttX 或 CP→AP handoff | 后置到 CP NSH 稳定后 |

“分区表要提前规划”这条对当前项目需要改写为：

```text
当前 L0：
  锁定并复现厂商 profile 的分区表
  不自行改变布局

未来产品阶段：
  若要引入 OpenVela AP、文件系统、OTA 或安全启动，
  必须新建、评审并迁移分区方案
```

现在如果自行在 `partition_table.c` 发明一张表，反而会与厂商 Bootloader metadata 和已验证 `all-app.bin` 断开。

```text

  vendor all-app.bin → bk_loader → 原生启动

L1-CP：OpenVela CP 编译组件                 未实现
```

所以，当前文档最值得新增的是一小节：

> **“L1 raw component、L1-SWD RAM debug、L2-dev Flash boot package 的边界”**

其核心规则应是：

## [S5] Build and package contract

两个 board CMake build 各自只负责导出本组件：

```text
CP NuttX link/post-processing
  nuttx.bin
    → bk7258/app.bin

AP NuttX link/post-processing
  nuttx.bin
    → bk7258/app1.bin
```

合包脚本在两个明确的 component input 之后执行：

```text
package_bk7258.py
  staged Bootloader + CP app.bin + AP app1.bin + partition inputs
    → Beken 32-to-34 CRC package
    → images/bk7258/all-app.bin + manifest.json
```

CP/AP 各自的 `nuttx_post_build` 只导出该 component raw image、ELF 和 map；
它们不烧录、签名、调用下载器、编译对方 component 或修改外部厂商资产。合包
脚本接收两个明确 component input path 与一个 profile，使用单独 output
directory；它不隐式寻找“最新”构建目录。每个 component output 必须附带 role、
profile compatibility、ELF/raw SHA-256、链接地址与容量，以拒绝角色错配、
过期 profile 或 CP image 被当作 AP image 的合包。

当前 L0 合包命令以厂商 `app1.bin` 作为显式 AP input；未来 AP build 可用同一
参数位置替换。合包器不自动发起 CP/AP build，从而允许两者独立构建、缓存、
审阅与复现。

### Bootloader staging contract

包装器不得只复制 normal Bootloader。当前 locked profile 的 staging input 必须
严格按以下顺序生成：

```text
normal bootloader.bin
  → 用 0x00 对齐到 32-byte 边界
  → 追加 bk_ota_partitions.json.part_table 的序列化字节
  → 将整个 staging Bootloader 按 32-byte payload + CRC16-BE 编码
  → 作为 bootloader section 写入 physical offset 0x00000000
```

`part_table` 必须以 JSON 数组的原始顺序序列化；每个条目为 64 bytes：

```text
magic       : uint32 little-endian
name        : 24-byte UTF-8，NUL 补齐
flash_name  : 24-byte UTF-8，NUL 补齐
offset      : uint32 little-endian
len         : uint32 little-endian
crc32       : uint32 little-endian，覆盖本条目前述 60 bytes
```

Bootloader 的 metadata alignment 使用 `0x00`；CP/AP raw component 最后一个
不足 32-byte payload block 才以 `0xff` 补齐后计算 CRC16。这两种 padding 不得
混淆。

### Container and SDK-flow boundary

本 profile 的正式输出是 **linear-CRC physical-flash image**：CRC 展开的三个
section 按 `bk_package.json` physical offset 线性写入。它没有 BKDLV10 下载
容器头、BL1/BL2/MCUboot 签名头或其他安全镜像头；`bk_package.json` 的

包装器可复用 SDK 的受控子步骤（Bootloader staging、`bk_packager_linear_crc`

`all-app.bin` 后生成 OTA/下载附属产物，超出本 profile 的边界。

1. 仅接受 profile 锁定且 SHA-256 匹配的 normal Bootloader、

## 3. CPU0 image and startup contract

The eventual CPU0 chip layer will provide a BK7258-specific reset/start file
that uses NuttX ARMv8-M interfaces and ends at `nx_start()`.

Required order:

```text
CPU0 reset / BootROM handoff
  → establish initial stack without starting or configuring CPU1/CPU2
  → install CPU0 vector base / required ARM exception state
  → copy .data and clear .bss
  → apply only verified clock and reset-gate operations
  → initialize polling UART0 enough for fatal diagnostics
  → initialize NuttX heap boundaries
  → nx_start()
```

The design intentionally excludes these actions before minimal NSH succeeds:

- Starting CPU1 or CPU2, loading the AP image, or calling mailbox IPC.
- Enabling PSRAM, AP RAM allocations, media memory, or TCM code relocation.
- Enabling a TrustZone multi-image handoff or assuming the AP secure policy.
- Enabling UART, timer, GPIO, I2C, or SPI interrupts before the NuttX IRQ
  controller path is verified.

## 4. Linker and memory contract

The production linker script must be created only after the blocked items in
section 2 are resolved. Its initial responsibilities are:

1. Emit one CPU0 vector table with the alignment required by BK7258.
2. Set the NuttX reset/vector entry compatible with the verified CPU0 image
   handoff.
3. Place `.text`/`.rodata` in the verified executable CPU0 Flash region.
4. Copy `.data` into, and clear `.bss` in, verified CPU0 SRAM.
5. Reserve the idle stack, any required interrupt stack, then define one
   contiguous L0 heap from the remaining verified CPU0 SRAM.
6. Export only the symbols required by the NuttX ARM startup and heap code.

vectors, media slabs, or vendor-specific swap/CRC regions unless their use is
proven necessary for a CPU0 NuttX image.

images coexist in the complete product firmware. It does **not** establish
that NuttX should replace the entire `all-app.bin`, use the same virtual
addresses, or reuse its partition/header format.

## 5. Early UART0 contract

## 7. T3 exit criteria

T3 is ready for implementation only when all items below are recorded with a
source and reviewed:

- CPU0 image handoff rule: image format, load address/offset, reset entry and
  required integrity/security processing.
- Exact L0 Flash and SRAM ranges, including stack and heap placement.
- Vector table alignment and VTOR policy.
- L0 FPU, MPU, cache, CMSE/SAU and TCM policy.
- UART0 clock/reset/pinmux sequence and an agreed initial baud rate.
- Chosen system timer, ICU source and NVIC mapping for NuttX `arch_alarm`.
- Reproducible CPU0-only flashing procedure and expected UART observation.

Until then this contract is design evidence, not authorization to write a
bootable linker script or claim a CPU0 firmware can boot.

# Skill: modern-python-toolchain

# Modern Python Toolchain

A guide for setting up Python projects with modern, fast tooling: **uv** (package/project manager), **ruff** (linter/formatter), and **pyright** (type checker).

## Installing uv

uv is an extremely fast Python package and project manager. It replaces pip, pip-tools, pipx, pyenv, virtualenv, poetry, etc.

```bash
# macOS / Linux
curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh

# Windows (PowerShell)
powershell -ExecutionPolicy ByPass -c "irm https://astral.sh/uv/install.ps1 | iex"

# Homebrew (macOS)
brew install uv
```

After installation, restart your shell or run `source $HOME/.local/bin/env` (the installer prints the exact command).

For detailed information: https://docs.astral.sh/uv/

---

## uv basics

### Python version

Pin a single Python minor version. The recommended default is 3.12 (broadest ecosystem support — PyTorch, CUDA images, downstream libraries). Python 3.14 is the latest stable; prefer it for new projects unless you depend on packages that haven't added 3.14 support yet.

```toml
# pyproject.toml
requires-python = "==3.12.*"
```

Install Python via uv (no system Python needed):

```bash
uv python install 3.12
```

### Creating a new project

```bash
uv init                       # Create new project with pyproject.toml
uv init -p 3.12               # Specify Python version
```

### Common commands

```bash
uv add requests               # Add dependency
uv add --dev ruff "pyright[nodejs]"  # Add dev dependencies
uv remove requests            # Remove dependency
uv sync                       # Install from lockfile
uv run COMMAND                # Run command in project environment
uv run script.py              # Run a script
uv run python -c "..."        # Run Python one-liner
uvx TOOL ARGS                 # Run a tool without installing it
```

### Rules

- **Never use `pip`** in uv projects — always `uv add` for packages.
- **Never run `python script.py` directly** — always `uv run script.py` to ensure the correct environment. For one-liners use `uv run python -c "..."`.
- **Don't manually manage environments** with `python -m venv` or `source .venv/bin/activate` — uv handles this automatically.
- `uvx` runs tools from PyPI by package name without installing them permanently.

### Project types

For **library** projects (`uv init --lib`) or packaged apps (`uv init --package`), `uv_build` is used as the default build backend automatically:

```toml
[build-system]
# auto-generated by uv init; version bound tracks your installed uv (here: 0.11.28)
requires = ["uv_build>=0.11.28,<0.12.0"]
build-backend = "uv_build"
```

For **application** projects with an entry point:

```toml
[project.scripts]
myapp = "myapp.__main__:main"
```

If the project does not use src layout, just run `uv run main.py`.

---

## ruff

Ruff is an extremely fast Python linter and code formatter. It replaces Flake8, isort, Black, pyupgrade, autoflake, and more.

For detailed information: https://docs.astral.sh/ruff/

### When to use

Always use ruff for Python linting and formatting. Prefer `uv run ruff` when ruff is a dev dependency; otherwise fall back to `uvx ruff`.

### Configuration

Add to `pyproject.toml`:

```toml
[tool.ruff.lint]
extend-select = [
    "UP",  # pyupgrade
    "I",   # isort
]
```

Do not enable the full `E` category or other formatter-conflicting rules (E1xx, E501, W191, Q, COM); `ruff format` owns layout.

### Post-edit workflow

After modifying Python code, run both:

```bash
uv run ruff check --fix path/to/changed_file.py
uv run ruff format path/to/changed_file.py
```

Use `--diff` to preview changes without applying.

---

## pyright

Pyright is a fast type checker for Python. Only use it when the project lists it as a dev dependency or explicitly uses type checking.

Install with the `nodejs` extra so Node.js is bundled automatically (no system `node` required):

```bash
uv add --dev "pyright[nodejs]"
```

Run type checking:

```bash
uv run pyright path/to/changed_file.py    # check specific files
uv run pyright src/                        # check all code
```

Usually only check the files you modified. For broad changes (base classes, shared types), check the full tree.

---

## Coding style

### Type annotations

Use modern Python 3.12+ syntax:

```python
# Good — builtin generics, union syntax
def fetch(url: str, timeout: float = 30.0) -> list[dict[str, str | None]]:
    ...

# Bad — legacy typing imports
from typing import List, Dict, Optional
def fetch(url: str, timeout: float = 30.0) -> List[Dict[str, Optional[str]]]:
    ...
```

Always annotate function parameters. Local variables can rely on inference unless the type is ambiguous:

```python
items: list[tuple[str, int]] = []    # annotate — empty literal
config: dict[str, Any] = {}          # annotate — empty literal
result = some_api()                  # inference is fine
```

### pydantic v2

Use the modern class-based API:
- `model_config = ConfigDict(...)` at class body level, not `class Config`.
- `RootModel` with `root: SomeType` for single-root schemas.

### typer (CLI)

Recommended for CLI entry points over `argparse`:

```python
import typer
from typing import Annotated

cli = typer.Typer(add_completion=False)

@cli.command()
def main(name: Annotated[str, typer.Argument(help="Your name")]) -> None:
    typer.echo(f"Hello {name}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    cli()
```

"""Validate and stage the locked BK7258 L2-dev vendor profile.

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import binascii
import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path


LOCAL_CMAKE_PATTERN = re.compile(
    r'^\s*set\(\s*(BK7258_(?:ARMINO_SDK_ROOT|BEKEN_GENIE_BUILD_ROOT))\s+"([^"]+)"\s*\)\s*$'
)
SIZE_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^(0x[0-9a-fA-F]+|\d+)([KkMm])?$")
REQUIRED_LOCAL_KEYS = {
    "BK7258_ARMINO_SDK_ROOT",
    "BK7258_BEKEN_GENIE_BUILD_ROOT",
}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class VerifiedFile:
    label: str
    path: Path
    length: int
    sha256: str


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Validate and stage the locked BK7258 vendor packaging profile."
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--profile",
        type=Path,
        required=True,
        help="Path to bk7258-devkit-l0-vendor-ap.json.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--inputs-cmake",
        type=Path,
        required=True,
        help="Local-only CMake file that locates the external SDK and build tree.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output-dir",
        type=Path,
        required=True,
        help="Empty or managed directory for generated staging artifacts.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--write-report",
        action="store_true",
        help="Write validated-profile.json alongside staged-bootloader.bin.",
    )
    return parser.parse_args()


def fail(message: str) -> None:
    raise RuntimeError(message)


def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as source:
        for block in iter(lambda: source.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def parse_local_cmake(path: Path) -> dict[str, Path]:
    if not path.is_file():
        fail(f"local input file does not exist: {path}")

    values: dict[str, Path] = {}
    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        match = LOCAL_CMAKE_PATTERN.match(line)
        if match:
            values[match.group(1)] = Path(match.group(2)).expanduser()

    missing = REQUIRED_LOCAL_KEYS.difference(values)
    if missing:
        fail(f"{path} is missing required keys: {', '.join(sorted(missing))}")

    for key, value in values.items():
        if not value.is_dir():
            fail(f"{key} is not an existing directory: {value}")

    return values


def parse_size(value: str | int) -> int:
    text = str(value)
    match = SIZE_PATTERN.match(text)
    if not match:
        fail(f"unsupported partition-size value: {value!r}")

    size = int(match.group(1), 0)
    suffix = match.group(2)
    if suffix in {"K", "k"}:
        size *= 1024
    elif suffix in {"M", "m"}:
        size *= 1024 * 1024
    return size


def fixed_string(value: str, length: int, label: str) -> bytes:
    encoded = value.encode("utf-8")
    if len(encoded) > length:
        fail(f"{label} exceeds {length} UTF-8 bytes: {value!r}")
    return encoded.ljust(length, b"\x00")


def serialize_partition_table(path: Path) -> bytes:
    try:
        partition_document = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
        fail(f"cannot parse partition JSON {path}: {exc}")

    part_table = partition_document.get("part_table")
    if not isinstance(part_table, list) or not part_table:
        fail(f"{path} has no non-empty part_table array")

    encoded_table = bytearray()
    for index, part in enumerate(part_table):
        try:
            record = bytearray()
            record.extend(int(str(part["magic"]), 0).to_bytes(4, "little"))
            record.extend(fixed_string(str(part["name"]), 24, f"part_table[{index}].name"))
            record.extend(
                fixed_string(
                    str(part["flash_name"]),
                    24,
                    f"part_table[{index}].flash_name",
                )
            )
            record.extend(int(str(part["offset"]), 0).to_bytes(4, "little"))
            record.extend(parse_size(part["len"]).to_bytes(4, "little"))
        except (KeyError, OverflowError, ValueError) as exc:
            fail(f"invalid part_table[{index}] in {path}: {exc}")

        if len(record) != 60:
            fail(f"part_table[{index}] serialized to {len(record)} bytes, expected 60")

        record.extend((binascii.crc32(record) & 0xFFFFFFFF).to_bytes(4, "little"))
        encoded_table.extend(record)

    return bytes(encoded_table)


def verify_file(
    label: str,
    root: Path,
    entry: dict[str, object],
) -> VerifiedFile:
    relative_path = entry.get("relative_path")
    expected_hash = entry.get("sha256")
    expected_length = entry.get("raw_length_bytes", entry.get("length_bytes"))
    if not isinstance(relative_path, str) or not isinstance(expected_hash, str):
        fail(f"profile input {label} lacks relative_path or sha256")

    path = root / relative_path
    if not path.is_file():
        fail(f"locked profile input is missing: {label}: {path}")

    length = path.stat().st_size
    if expected_length is not None and length != expected_length:
        fail(
            f"{label} length mismatch: expected {expected_length}, got {length}: {path}"
        )

    digest = sha256_file(path)
    if digest != expected_hash:
        fail(f"{label} SHA-256 mismatch: expected {expected_hash}, got {digest}: {path}")

    return VerifiedFile(label, path, length, digest)


def verify_staged_copy(
    label: str,
    root: Path,
    entry: dict[str, object],
) -> VerifiedFile:
    staged_relative_path = entry.get("staged_relative_path")

def validate_package_layout(package_path: Path, profile: dict[str, object]) -> None:
    try:

    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
        fail(f"cannot parse package JSON {package_path}: {exc}")

    if package.get("crc_enable") is not True:
        fail(f"{package_path} does not enable CRC packaging")

    sections = package.get("section")
    if not isinstance(sections, list):
        fail(f"{package_path} has no section array")

    expected = {
        "bootloader": profile["partitions"]["bootloader"],

    status = subprocess.run(

        text=True,
        capture_output=True,
        check=False,
    )
    if status.returncode != 0:
        fail(f"cannot inspect SDK worktree state at {sdk_root}: {status.stderr.strip()}")

    return {"revision": revision, "dirty": bool(status.stdout.strip())}

def crc16(data: bytes, offset: int, length: int):
    if offset < 0 or offset + length > len(data):
        return 0
    crc = 0xFFFFFFFF

    # beken poly:8005
    for i in range(length):
        crc ^= data[offset + i] << 8
        for _ in range(8):
            crc = (crc << 1) ^ 0x8005 if (crc & 0x8000) else (crc << 1)
    return crc & 0xFFFF


class bk_crc16:
    CRC_PACK_LEN = 32
    PADDING_BYTE = bytes([0xFF])

    def compute_crced_size(self, raw_size: int) -> int:
        return (
            (raw_size + self.CRC_PACK_LEN - 1)
            // self.CRC_PACK_LEN
            * (self.CRC_PACK_LEN + 2)
        )

    def crc_file(self, raw_file: Path, output_file: Path):
        self.file_path = raw_file.parent

        operate_file = self._backup_file(raw_file)
        self._file_align_handle(operate_file)
        self._crc16_handle(operate_file, output_file)
        operate_file.unlink()

    def crc16_data(self, raw_data: bytes) -> bytes:
        raw_data = self._data_align_handle(raw_data)
        output_data = bytearray()
        for i in range(0, len(raw_data), self.CRC_PACK_LEN):
            chunk = raw_data[i : i + self.CRC_PACK_LEN]
            output_data.extend(chunk)
            crc = crc16(chunk, 0, self.CRC_PACK_LEN).to_bytes(2, byteorder="big")
            output_data.extend(crc)

        return bytes(output_data)

    def _file_align_handle(self, operate_file: Path):
        file_size = operate_file.stat().st_size
        if file_size % self.CRC_PACK_LEN == 0:
            return

        padding_len = self.CRC_PACK_LEN - (file_size % self.CRC_PACK_LEN)
        logger.info(f"{padding_len=}")
        with operate_file.open("ab") as f:
            f.write(self.PADDING_BYTE * padding_len)

    def _backup_file(self, raw_file: Path) -> Path:
        raw_file_name = raw_file.parent
        operate_file_name = "bk_crc_" + raw_file_name.name
        operate_file_path = self.file_path / operate_file_name
        if operate_file_path.exists():
            operate_file_path.unlink()
        shutil.copy(raw_file, operate_file_path)
        return operate_file_path

    def _crc16_handle(self, operate_file: Path, output_file: Path):
        output_bytes = bytearray()
        chunk_size = 4096
        with operate_file.open("rb") as file:
            while True:
                data_chunk = file.read(chunk_size)
                if not data_chunk:
                    break
                output_bytes.extend(self.crc16_data(data_chunk))

        if output_file.exists():
            output_file.unlink()

        output_file.write_bytes(output_bytes)

    def _data_align_handle(self, raw_data: bytes):
        data_len = len(raw_data)
        if data_len % self.CRC_PACK_LEN == 0:
            return raw_data

        padding_len = self.CRC_PACK_LEN - (data_len % self.CRC_PACK_LEN)
        logger.debug(f"{padding_len=}")

        return raw_data + self.PADDING_BYTE * padding_len

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build the locked BK7258 L2-dev linear-CRC Flash image.

This tool calls only the locked SDK's bk_packager_linear_crc substep. It never
calls the SDK's post-package/OTA flow, the downloader, or any hardware tool.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import validate_bk7258_profile as profile_validator


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Package a locked BK7258 CP/AP component set into all-app.bin."
    )
    parser.add_argument("--profile", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--inputs-cmake", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--cp-app-bin", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--ap-app-bin",
        type=Path,
        required=True,
        help="Explicit AP input. The L0 profile accepts only its locked vendor app1.bin.",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    return parser.parse_args()


def fail(message: str) -> None:
    raise RuntimeError(message)


def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as source:
        for block in iter(lambda: source.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def require_raw_component(
    label: str,
    path: Path,
    maximum_length: int,
) -> tuple[int, str]:
    if not path.is_file():
        fail(f"{label} input does not exist: {path}")
    length = path.stat().st_size
    if length < 8:
        fail(f"{label} input is too short to hold a Cortex-M vector prefix: {path}")
    if length > maximum_length:
        fail(
            f"{label} input exceeds its raw profile capacity: "
            f"{length} > {maximum_length}: {path}"
        )
    return length, sha256_file(path)


def run_profile_gate(
    script_path: Path,
    profile_path: Path,
    inputs_cmake: Path,
    staging_dir: Path,
) -> dict[str, object]:
    command = [
        sys.executable,
        str(script_path),
        "--profile",
        str(profile_path),
        "--inputs-cmake",
        str(inputs_cmake),
        "--output-dir",
        str(staging_dir),
        "--write-report",
    ]
    result = subprocess.run(command, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
    if result.returncode != 0:
        fail(f"profile gate failed:\n{result.stderr.strip()}")

    report_path = staging_dir / "validated-profile.json"
    if not report_path.is_file():
        fail(f"profile gate did not create {report_path}")
    return json.loads(report_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def build_sdk_package(
    sdk_root: Path,
    work_dir: Path,
    package_json: Path,
    output_image: Path,
) -> None:
    sdk_python_path = sdk_root / "tools/env_tools/bk_py_libs"
    if not sdk_python_path.is_dir():
        fail(f"locked SDK Python library directory is missing: {sdk_python_path}")

    source = (
        "from pathlib import Path\n"
        "import bk_packager\n"
        f"packer = bk_packager.bk_packager_linear_crc(Path({str(work_dir)!r}), "
        f"Path({str(package_json)!r}), Path({str(output_image)!r}))\n"
        "packer.pack()\n"
    )
    environment = os.environ.copy()
    environment["PYTHONPATH"] = str(sdk_python_path)
    result = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-c", source],
        text=True,
        capture_output=True,
        env=environment,
        check=False,
    )
    if result.returncode != 0:
        fail(f"locked SDK linear-CRC packer failed:\n{result.stderr.strip()}")

    # SDK bk_build_package.py additionally aligns its all-app.bin output to a
    # 32-byte boundary after bk_packager_linear_crc appends its 34-byte tail.
    output_length = output_image.stat().st_size
    trailing_alignment = (-output_length) % 32
    if trailing_alignment:
        with output_image.open("ab") as output:
            output.write(b"\xff" * trailing_alignment)


def main() -> int:
    args = parse_args()
    try:
        profile = json.loads(args.profile.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if profile.get("profile") != "bk7258-devkit-l0-vendor-ap":
            fail(f"unsupported profile: {profile.get('profile')!r}")
        if profile.get("container", {}).get("mode") != "linear-crc-physical-flash":
            fail("profile is not a linear-CRC physical-flash profile")

        output_dir = args.output_dir.resolve()
        staging_dir = output_dir / "staging"
        work_dir = output_dir / "packer-work"
        output_image = output_dir / "all-app.bin"
        output_manifest = output_dir / "manifest.json"

        if output_image.exists() or output_manifest.exists():
            fail(
                f"refusing to overwrite existing package output in {output_dir}; "
                "use a new output directory or remove prior generated outputs explicitly"
            )

        profile_gate = run_profile_gate(
            Path(__file__).with_name("validate_bk7258_profile.py"),
            args.profile.resolve(),
            args.inputs_cmake.resolve(),
            staging_dir,
        )
        local_inputs = profile_validator.parse_local_cmake(args.inputs_cmake.resolve())
        build_root = local_inputs["BK7258_BEKEN_GENIE_BUILD_ROOT"]
        sdk_root = local_inputs["BK7258_ARMINO_SDK_ROOT"]

        cp_length, cp_hash = require_raw_component(
            "CP", args.cp_app_bin.resolve(), profile["partitions"]["cp"]["raw_max_bytes"]
        )
        ap_length, ap_hash = require_raw_component(
            "AP", args.ap_app_bin.resolve(), profile["partitions"]["ap"]["raw_max_bytes"]
        )
        vendor_ap = profile["locked_inputs"]["vendor_ap_input"]
        if ap_length != vendor_ap["raw_length_bytes"] or ap_hash != vendor_ap["sha256"]:
            fail(
                "the L0 profile accepts only its SHA-256-locked vendor AP input; "
                "an OpenVela AP component requires a later profile"
            )

        work_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
        shutil.copy2(staging_dir / "staged-bootloader.bin", work_dir / "bootloader.bin")
        shutil.copy2(args.cp_app_bin.resolve(), work_dir / "app.bin")
        shutil.copy2(args.ap_app_bin.resolve(), work_dir / "app1.bin")
        package_json = build_root / profile["locked_inputs"]["package_json"]["relative_path"]
        work_package_json = work_dir / "bk_package.json"
        shutil.copy2(package_json, work_package_json)

        output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        build_sdk_package(sdk_root, work_dir, work_package_json, output_image)
        output_hash = sha256_file(output_image)

        manifest = {
            "schema_version": 1,
            "profile": profile["profile"],
            "container_mode": profile["container"]["mode"],
            "profile_path": str(args.profile.resolve()),
            "profile_sha256": sha256_file(args.profile.resolve()),
            "components": {
                "bootloader": {
                    **profile_gate["staged_bootloader"],
                    "physical_offset": profile["partitions"]["bootloader"]["physical_offset"],
                    "physical_size": profile["partitions"]["bootloader"]["physical_size"],
                },
                "cp": {
                    "path": str(args.cp_app_bin.resolve()),
                    "raw_length_bytes": cp_length,
                    "sha256": cp_hash,
                    "physical_offset": profile["partitions"]["cp"]["physical_offset"],
                    "physical_size": profile["partitions"]["cp"]["physical_size"],
                    "xip_vector_base": profile["partitions"]["cp"]["xip_vector_base"],
                },
                "ap": {
                    "path": str(args.ap_app_bin.resolve()),
                    "raw_length_bytes": ap_length,
                    "sha256": ap_hash,
                    "physical_offset": profile["partitions"]["ap"]["physical_offset"],
                    "physical_size": profile["partitions"]["ap"]["physical_size"],
                    "source": "locked-vendor-input",
                },
            },
            "image": {
                "path": str(output_image),
                "length_bytes": output_image.stat().st_size,
                "sha256": output_hash,
            },
            "profile_gate": profile_gate,
            "packer": {
                "sdk_root": str(sdk_root),
                "sdk_revision": profile["locked_inputs"]["armino_sdk"]["revision"],
                "implementation": "bk_packager.bk_packager_linear_crc",
                "ota_or_download_flow_invoked": False,
            },
        }
        output_manifest.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        print(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2))
        return 0
    except (KeyError, OSError, RuntimeError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
        print(f"error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

        description="Decode and independently verify a BK7258 linear-CRC package."
    )
    parser.add_argument("--image", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--manifest", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--report", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--compare-cp", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--compare-ap", type=Path)
    return parser.parse_args()


def fail(message: str) -> None:
    raise RuntimeError(message)


def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as source:
        for block in iter(lambda: source.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def crc16(payload: bytes) -> int:
    if len(payload) != 32:
        fail(f"CRC payload is {len(payload)} bytes, expected 32")
    value = 0xFFFFFFFF
    for byte in payload:
        value ^= byte << 8
        for _ in range(8):
            value = ((value << 1) ^ 0x8005) if value & 0x8000 else value << 1
    return value & 0xFFFF


def decode_component(
    image: bytes,
    label: str,
    offset: int,
    raw_length: int,
    expected_hash: str,
) -> dict[str, object]:
    encoded_length = ((raw_length + 31) // 32) * 34
    encoded = image[offset : offset + encoded_length]
    if len(encoded) != encoded_length:
        fail(
            f"{label} encoded range is truncated: expected {encoded_length} bytes "
            f"at 0x{offset:08x}, got {len(encoded)}"
        )

    decoded = bytearray()
    for block_offset in range(0, encoded_length, 34):
        payload = encoded[block_offset : block_offset + 32]
        stored_crc = int.from_bytes(encoded[block_offset + 32 : block_offset + 34], "big")
        actual_crc = crc16(payload)
        if stored_crc != actual_crc:
            fail(
                f"{label} CRC mismatch at physical 0x{offset + block_offset:08x}: "
                f"expected 0x{stored_crc:04x}, got 0x{actual_crc:04x}"
            )
        decoded.extend(payload)

    raw = bytes(decoded[:raw_length])
    padding = decoded[raw_length:]
    if padding and any(byte != 0xFF for byte in padding):
        fail(f"{label} final CRC payload padding is not all 0xff")
    digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    if digest != expected_hash:
        fail(f"{label} decoded SHA-256 mismatch: expected {expected_hash}, got {digest}")

    return {
        "label": label,
        "physical_offset": f"0x{offset:08x}",
        "raw_length_bytes": raw_length,
        "encoded_length_bytes": encoded_length,
        "raw_sha256": digest,
        "raw": raw,
    }


def compare_raw(label: str, decoded: bytes, source: Path | None) -> None:
    if source is None:
        return
    if not source.is_file():
        fail(f"{label} comparison file is missing: {source}")
    expected = source.read_bytes()
    if decoded != expected:
        fail(f"{label} decoded bytes differ from explicit comparison input: {source}")


def physical_offset(component: dict[str, object], label: str) -> int:
    value = component.get("physical_offset")
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        fail(f"{label} manifest entry lacks physical_offset")
    return int(value, 0)


def physical_size(component: dict[str, object], label: str) -> int:
    value = component.get("physical_size")
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        fail(f"{label} manifest entry lacks physical_size")
    return int(value, 0)


def validate_ff_padding(image: bytes, start: int, end: int, label: str) -> None:
    if end < start:
        fail(f"{label} padding bounds are inverted")
    padding = image[start:end]
    if any(byte != 0xFF for byte in padding):
        fail(f"{label} physical padding is not all 0xff")

    args = parse_args()
    try:
        manifest = json.loads(args.manifest.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if manifest.get("container_mode") != "linear-crc-physical-flash":
            fail("manifest is not a linear-CRC physical-flash package")

            fail("image length differs from manifest")
        if sha256_file(args.image) != image_entry.get("sha256"):

        bootloader = components["bootloader"]
        cp = components["cp"]
        ap = components["ap"]
        bootloader_offset = physical_offset(bootloader, "bootloader")
        cp_offset = physical_offset(cp, "cp")
        ap_offset = physical_offset(ap, "ap")
        if bootloader_offset != 0:
            fail(f"bootloader physical offset must be zero, got 0x{bootloader_offset:08x}")
        if not bootloader_offset < cp_offset < ap_offset:
            fail("component physical offsets are not strictly increasing")
        decoded_bootloader = decode_component(
            image,
            "bootloader",
            bootloader_offset,
            bootloader["raw_length_bytes"],
            bootloader["sha256"],
        )
        decoded_cp = decode_component(
            image,
            "cp",
            cp_offset,
            cp["raw_length_bytes"],
            cp["sha256"],
        )
        decoded_ap = decode_component(
            image,
            "ap",
            ap_offset,
            ap["raw_length_bytes"],
            ap["sha256"],
        )
        compare_raw("CP", decoded_cp.pop("raw"), args.compare_cp)
        compare_raw("AP", decoded_ap.pop("raw"), args.compare_ap)
        decoded_bootloader.pop("raw")

        component_details = [
            ("bootloader", bootloader, decoded_bootloader, bootloader_offset),
            ("cp", cp, decoded_cp, cp_offset),
            ("ap", ap, decoded_ap, ap_offset),
        ]
        for label, component, decoded, offset in component_details:
            encoded_end = offset + decoded["encoded_length_bytes"]
            if decoded["encoded_length_bytes"] > physical_size(component, label):

def set_logging():

def backup_bootloader_path():
    # copy bootloader elf-map-asm to build directory
    bootloader_build_dir = curr_project.bootloader_build_path.parent
    if not bootloader_build_dir.exists():
        logger.debug("bootloader not build, not backup.")
        return

    bootloader_backup_path = curr_project.bootloader_backup_dir
    bootloader_backup_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if bootloader_backup_path.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(bootloader_backup_path)

    shutil.copytree(bootloader_build_dir, bootloader_backup_path)
    logger.info(f"backup bootloader to {bootloader_backup_path}")


def pack_all_bin(pack_dir: Path, pack_json: Path, output_bin: Path):
    def binary_align_32_byte(bin_path: Path):
        if not bin_path.exists():
            raise RuntimeError(f"{bin_path} no exist.")
        bin_size = output_bin.stat().st_size
        padding_size = (32 - bin_size % 32) % 32
        with bin_path.open("ab") as f:
            f.write(bytes([0xFF] * padding_size))

    if not pack_json.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"{pack_json} not found")
    pack_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    packager = curr_project.get_packager(pack_dir, pack_json, output_bin)
    packager.pack()
    # cmake_Gen_img 32byte align, so do same here.
    binary_align_32_byte(output_bin)

def pre_link(func: Callable[[T], None]):
    def wrapper(self: T):
        for index, part_item in enumerate(self.part_info):
            crced_data = crc_handler.crc16_data(part_item.data)
            if len(crced_data) > part_item.size:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"partition {part_item.name} binary length over partition size after crc"

            crced_part_item = PartitionInfo(

            )
            self.part_info[index] = crced_part_item
        return func(self)

    crc_handler = bk_crc16()
    return wrapper


def post_link(func: Callable[[T], None]):
    def wrapper(self: T):
        # for ensure pre-read code length have 34 bytes at least.
        ret = func(self)
        with self.output_file.open("ab") as f:
            f.write(bytes([0xFF] * 34))
        return ret

    return wrapper

typedef volatile struct {
	/* REG_0x00 */
	uint32_t dev_id;

	/* REG_0x01 */
	uint32_t dev_version;

	/* REG_0x02 */
	union {
		struct {
			uint32_t soft_reset:      1; /**< bit[0] uart soft reset */
			uint32_t clk_gate_bypass: 1; /**< bit[1] bypass uart clock gate */
			uint32_t reserved:       30; /**< bit[2:31] reserved */
		};
		uint32_t v;
	} global_ctrl;

	/* REG_0x03 */
	uint32_t dev_status;

	/* REG_0x04 */
	union {
		struct {
			uint32_t tx_enable:  1; /**< bit[0] uart tx enable */
			uint32_t rx_enable:  1; /**< bit[1] uart rx enable */
			uint32_t reserved1:  1; /**< bit[2] */
			/* uart length
			 * 0: 5bit
			 * 1: 6bit
			 * 2: 7bit
			 * 3: 8bit
			 */
			uint32_t data_bits: 2; /**< bit[3:4] data bits */
			uint32_t parity_en: 1; /**< bit[5] 0: disable, 1: enable */
			uint32_t parity:    1; /**< bit[6] parity 0: Even, 1: Odd */
			uint32_t stop_bits: 1; /**< bit[7] stop bits, 0: 1 bit, 1: 2bit */
			uint32_t clk_div:   16; /**< bit[8:23] clk_div = uart_clk/baud_rate */
			uint32_t reserved:  8;  /**< bit[24:31] */
		};
		uint32_t v;
	} config;

	/* REG_0x05 */
	union {
		struct {
			uint32_t tx_fifo_threshold:   8; /**< bit[0:7] */
			uint32_t rx_fifo_threshold:   8; /**< bit[8:15] */
			/* rx stop detect time
			 * 0: 32
			 * 1: 64
			 * 2: 128
			 * 3: 256
			 */
			uint32_t rx_stop_detect_time: 2; /**< bit[16:17] */
			uint32_t reserved:            14;
		};
		uint32_t v;
	} fifo_config;

	/* REG_0x06 */
	union {
		struct {
			uint32_t tx_fifo_count: 8; /**< bit[0:7] */
			uint32_t rx_fifo_count: 8; /**< bit[8:15] */
			uint32_t tx_fifo_full:  1; /**< bit[16] */
			uint32_t tx_fifo_empty: 1; /**< bit[17] */
			uint32_t rx_fifo_full:  1; /**< bit[18] */
			uint32_t rx_fifo_empty: 1; /**< bit[19] */
			uint32_t fifo_wr_ready: 1; /**< bit[20] */
			uint32_t fifo_rd_ready: 1; /**< bit[21] */
			uint32_t reserved:      10;
		};
		uint32_t v;
	} fifo_status;

	/* REG_0x07 */
	union {
		struct {
			uint32_t tx_fifo_data_in:  8; /**< bit[0:7] */
			uint32_t rx_fifo_data_out: 8; /**< bit[8:15] */
			uint32_t reserved:         16;

		uint32_t v;
	} fifo_port;

	/* REG_0x08 */
	union {
		struct {
			uint32_t tx_fifo_need_write: 1; /**< bit[0] */
			uint32_t rx_fifo_need_read:  1; /**< bit[1] */
			uint32_t rx_fifo_overflow:   1; /**< bit[2] */
			uint32_t rx_parity_err:      1; /**< bit[3] */
			uint32_t rx_stop_bits_err:   1; /**< bit[4] */
			uint32_t tx_finish:          1; /**< bit[5] */
			uint32_t rx_finish:          1; /**< bit[6] */
			uint32_t rxd_wakeup:         1; /**< bit[7] */
			uint32_t reserved:           24;

		uint32_t v;
	} int_enable;

	/* REG_0x09 */
	union {
		struct {
			uint32_t tx_fifo_need_write: 1; /**< bit[0] */
			uint32_t rx_fifo_need_read:  1; /**< bit[1] */
			uint32_t rx_fifo_overflow:   1; /**< bit[2] */
			uint32_t rx_parity_err:      1; /**< bit[3] */
			uint32_t rx_stop_bits_err:   1; /**< bit[4] */
			uint32_t tx_finish:          1; /**< bit[5] */
			uint32_t rx_finish:          1; /**< bit[6] */

			uint32_t reserved:           24;
		};

	} int_status;

    }\
    GLOBAL_INT_RESTORE();\

#if (CONFIG_SYSTEM_CTRL)
static void timer_clock_select(timer_id_t id, timer_src_clk_t mode)
{
	uint32_t group_index = 0;

	group_index = id / SOC_TIMER_CHAN_NUM_PER_GROUP;
	switch(group_index)
	{
		case 0:
			sys_drv_timer_select_clock(SYS_SEL_TIMER0, mode);
			break;
		case 1:
			sys_drv_timer_select_clock(SYS_SEL_TIMER1, mode);
			break;
		default:
			break;
	}
}

static void timer_clock_enable(timer_id_t id)
{
	uint32_t group_index = 0;

	group_index = id / SOC_TIMER_CHAN_NUM_PER_GROUP;
	switch(group_index)
	{
		case 0:
			sys_drv_dev_clk_pwr_up(CLK_PWR_ID_TIMER_1, CLK_PWR_CTRL_PWR_UP);
			break;
		case 1:
			sys_drv_dev_clk_pwr_up(CLK_PWR_ID_TIMER_2, CLK_PWR_CTRL_PWR_UP);
			break;
		case 2:
			sys_drv_dev_clk_pwr_up(CLK_PWR_ID_TIMER_3, CLK_PWR_CTRL_PWR_UP);
			break;
		default:
			break;
	}
}

static void timer_clock_disable(timer_id_t id)
{
	uint32_t group_index = 0;

	group_index = id / SOC_TIMER_CHAN_NUM_PER_GROUP;
	switch(group_index)
	{
		case 0:
			sys_drv_dev_clk_pwr_up(CLK_PWR_ID_TIMER_1, CLK_PWR_CTRL_PWR_DOWN);
			break;
		case 1:
			sys_drv_dev_clk_pwr_up(CLK_PWR_ID_TIMER_2, CLK_PWR_CTRL_PWR_DOWN);
			break;
		case 2:
			sys_drv_dev_clk_pwr_up(CLK_PWR_ID_TIMER_3, CLK_PWR_CTRL_PWR_DOWN);
			break;
		default:
			break;
	}
}

static void timer_interrupt_enable(timer_id_t id)
{
	uint32_t group_index = 0;

	group_index = id / SOC_TIMER_CHAN_NUM_PER_GROUP;
	switch(group_index)
	{
		case 0:
			sys_drv_int_enable(TIMER_INTERRUPT_CTRL_BIT);
			break;

		case 1:
			sys_drv_int_enable(TIMER1_INTERRUPT_CTRL_BIT);
			break;
		default:
			break;
	}
}
#endif

static void timer_chan_init_common(timer_id_t timer_id)
{
#if (CONFIG_SYSTEM_CTRL)
	timer_clock_select(timer_id, TIMER_SCLK_XTAL);
	timer_clock_enable(timer_id);
#else
	power_pwr_up_timer(timer_id);
#endif
}

static void timer_chan_deinit_common(timer_id_t timer_id)
{
    timer_hal_stop_common(&s_timer.hal, timer_id);
    timer_hal_reset_config_to_default(&s_timer.hal, timer_id);
#if (CONFIG_SYSTEM_CTRL)
	timer_clock_disable(timer_id);
#else
	power_pwr_down_timer(timer_id);
#endif
}

static void timer_chan_enable_interrupt_common(timer_id_t timer_id)
{
#if (CONFIG_SYSTEM_CTRL)
	timer_interrupt_enable(timer_id);
#else
    icu_enable_timer_interrupt();
#endif
    timer_hal_enable_interrupt(&s_timer.hal, timer_id);
}

<actor-notification>
Background sub-session "Audit BK7258 CP memory and security" (actor_id: explore-11) completed.
Result: ## Bottom line

**Do not hard-code a BK7258 CPU0 NuttX RAM region yet.** The SDK confirms a 640 KiB shared-SRAM physical fabric and its secure/non-secure aliases, but it does **not** provide a generated map/ELF, boot handoff, or enforced MPC/SAU output for the intended board. Existing `CP_RAM` regions are **project-specific allocations**, not RAM automatically available to NuttX.

The best concrete **candidate-only** carve-out from the minimal `sram_lite` layout is:

| Purpose | Candidate secure address | Candidate non-secure alias | Size | Status |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| CPU0 CP RAM/data | `0x2806c000–0x2809f6ff` | `0x3806c000–0x3809f6ff` | `0x33700` / 210,688 B | Candidate only |
| CPU0 instruction alias of that SRAM | `0x0806c000–0x0809f6ff` | `0x1806c000–0x1809f6ff` | `0x33700` | Candidate only |
| ITCM | `0x00020–0x00003fff` | `0x10000020–0x10003fff` | up to 16 KiB minus MPU reservation | Candidate only |
| DTCM, SMP CPU0 layout | `0x20000004–0x20003fdf` | `0x30000004–0x30003fdf` | `0x3fdc` in the CP `0x3fe0` configuration | Candidate only |

That SRAM candidate derives from the `sram_lite` input: AP spinlock occupies `0x28000000–0x2800ffff`; AP RAM consumes `0x5c000` bytes; then CP RAM is `0x33700` bytes. See `/home/czp/armino/bk_avdk_smp/projects/sram_lite/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv:6-10`. It is **not** evidence that this region is unused by a running vendor application or permitted by the production boot policy.

## Confirmed facts

### Physical SRAM and aliases

- The SDK describes a shared 640 KiB SRAM fabric, represented in the data domain as `0x28000000–0x2809ffff`; the source identifies six banks: 64 KiB, 64 KiB, then four 128 KiB banks:
  - `SMEM0`: `0x28000000–0x2800ffff`
  - `SMEM1`: `0x28010000–0x2801ffff`
  - `SMEM2`: `0x28020000–0x2803ffff`
  - `SMEM3`: `0x28040000–0x2805ffff`
  - `SMEM4`: `0x28060000–0x2807ffff`
  - `SMEM5`: `0x28080000–0x2809ffff`

  Evidence: `/home/czp/armino/bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/soc/bk7258/reg_base.h:36-41`; the project RAM inputs independently state base `0x28000000`, capacity 640 KiB at `/home/czp/armino/bk_avdk_smp/projects/sram_lite/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv:1-3`.

- The CP linker explicitly says four address windows map to the same physical shared memory:
  - instruction aliases: `0x08000000–0x0809ffff` and `0x18000000–0x1809ffff`;
  - data aliases: `0x28000000–0x2809ffff` and `0x38000000–0x3809ffff`.

  Evidence: `/home/czp/armino/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/soc/bk7258/bk7258_bsp.ld:35-46`.

- With `CONFIG_SPE=1`, the SDK treats the unshifted ranges as secure and derives a non-secure alias by adding `0x10000000`; with `CONFIG_SPE=0`, it instead adds that offset to normal SDK base addresses. This applies to ITCM, DTCM, flash, SRAM, PSRAM, and peripheral bases.

  Evidence: `/home/czp/armino/bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/soc/bk7258/reg_base.h:19-45`.

- The SDK MPU comments make the intended domain pairs explicit:
  - ITCM secure/non-secure: `0x00000` / `0x10000000`;
  - flash secure/non-secure: `0x02000000` / `0x12000000`;
  - SRAM instruction alias secure/non-secure: `0x08000000` / `0x18000000`;
  - DTCM secure/non-secure: `0x20000000` / `0x30000000`;
  - shared SRAM data alias secure/non-secure: `0x28000000` / `0x38000000`.

  Evidence: `/home/czp/armino/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/soc/bk7258/mpu_cfg.c:38-80`.

### Existing CP RAM is generated from project input

- The CP linker does not contain a fixed SRAM address. It gets `CONFIG_CP_RAM_ADDR` and `CONFIG_CP_RAM_SIZE` from generated `ram_regions.h`, then maps:
  - data RAM at `CONFIG_CP_RAM_ADDR`;
  - instruction SRAM at `CONFIG_CP_RAM_ADDR - 0x20000000`.

  Evidence: `/home/czp/armino/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/soc/bk7258/bk7258_bsp.ld:43-53`.

- The build generates `ram_regions.h` from the selected project’s `partitions/<soc>/ram_regions.csv`; it force-includes the result in compilation. Evidence:
  - `/home/czp/armino/bk_avdk_smp/tools/build_main.mk:169-175`
  - `/home/czp/armino/bk_avdk_smp/tools/build_tools/build_files/build_main.cmake:94-100`
  - `/home/czp/armino/bk_avdk_smp/tools/build_tools/build_process/bk_build_ram_regions.py:19-38`.

- The generator assigns an omitted CSV offset to the running end of the preceding region, validates capacity and overlap, and emits `CONFIG_<REGION>_ADDR/SIZE`. Evidence: `/home/czp/armino/bk_avdk_smp/tools/env_tools/bk_py_libs/bk_ram_region/bk_ram_region.py:73-145,150-167`.

- CP allocations materially differ among vendor projects, proving that CP RAM is a policy choice, not a chip reservation. Examples:
  - `sram_lite`: CP `0x33700`, starting at `0x2806c000`;
  - common application layout: CP `0x3b700`, starting at `0x28064000`;
  - Wi-Fi bridge: CP `0x4db00`;
  - audio/video layouts: CP `0x30b00`;
  - AP-powerdown layout: CP `0x2f700`.

## 3. CPU0 image and startup contract

The eventual CPU0 chip layer will provide a BK7258-specific reset/start file
that uses NuttX ARMv8-M interfaces and ends at `nx_start()`.

Required order:

```text
CPU0 reset / BootROM handoff
  → establish initial stack without starting or configuring CPU1/CPU2
  → install CPU0 vector base / required ARM exception state
  → copy .data and clear .bss
  → apply only verified clock and reset-gate operations
  → initialize polling UART0 enough for fatal diagnostics
  → initialize NuttX heap boundaries
  → nx_start()
```

The design intentionally excludes these actions before minimal NSH succeeds:

- Starting CPU1 or CPU2, loading the AP image, or calling mailbox IPC.
- Enabling PSRAM, AP RAM allocations, media memory, or TCM code relocation.
- Enabling a TrustZone multi-image handoff or assuming the AP secure policy.
- Enabling UART, timer, GPIO, I2C, or SPI interrupts before the NuttX IRQ
  controller path is verified.

## 4. Linker and memory contract

The production linker script must be created only after the blocked items in
section 2 are resolved. Its initial responsibilities are:

1. Emit one CPU0 vector table with the alignment required by BK7258.
2. Set the NuttX reset/vector entry compatible with the verified CPU0 image
   handoff.
3. Place `.text`/`.rodata` in the verified executable CPU0 Flash region.
4. Copy `.data` into, and clear `.bss` in, verified CPU0 SRAM.
5. Reserve the idle stack, any required interrupt stack, then define one
   contiguous L0 heap from the remaining verified CPU0 SRAM.
6. Export only the symbols required by the NuttX ARM startup and heap code.

For L0, the linker script must not allocate PSRAM, AP regions, CPU1/CPU2
vectors, media slabs, or vendor-specific swap/CRC regions unless their use is
proven necessary for a CPU0 NuttX image.

The Armino CP package is useful evidence that a bootloader plus CP and AP
images coexist in the complete product firmware. It does **not** establish
that NuttX should replace the entire `all-app.bin`, use the same virtual
addresses, or reuse its partition/header format.

## 5. Early UART0 contract

The first observable output is a polling UART0 console.

```text
BK7258 P11 / DL_0TX → board net TX0 → USB-to-UART bridge receive input
BK7258 P10 / DL_0RX → board net RX0 ← USB-to-UART bridge transmit output
```

The chip layer owns UART0 register access, clock/reset control and polling
transmit. The board layer owns the DevKit pinmux selection and console policy.
The final baud rate, UART clock source, pull configuration and register
sequence remain blocked until the TRM/SDK behavior is independently verified.

The first implementation milestone is one reliable transmit marker before
`nx_start()`. `/dev/console`, RX, UART IRQ and NSH interaction are later
milestones.

我建议选 **“受控最小真机探针”**，而不是先等待资料，也不是先做 SWD。

理由很简单：封包已经逐字节复现，剩下的关键问题是板上真实的 Bootloader 到 CPU0 的安全域、VTOR 和 SRAM 行为；这些仅靠 Datasheet、SDK 源码或 SWD 都不能替代 Flash cold boot 验证。探针失败也可立即用已验证的厂商 `all-app.bin` 恢复。

探针不是 NuttX，也不是正式 BSP。它只验证以下最小链路：

```text
locked all-app.bin

  → CPU0 secure-domain candidate
  → vector/MSP/VTOR candidate

  → UART0 TX-only marker
```

/* Configuration ************************************************************/

/* .bss and .data is always positioned in internal SRAM.  The remaining SRAM
 * after the static .bss, .data, and IDLE stack allocations are always added
 * to the heap.
 */

/****************************************************************************
 * Public Data
 ****************************************************************************/

/* _sbss is the start of the BSS region (see the linker script) _ebss is the
 * end of the BSS region (see the linker script). The idle task stack starts
 * at the end of BSS and is of size CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE.  The IDLE
 * thread is the thread that the system boots on and, eventually, becomes the
 * idle, do nothing task that runs only when there is nothing else to run.
 * The heap continues from there until the configured end of memory.
 * g_idle_topstack is the beginning of this heap region (not necessarily
 * aligned).
 */

const uintptr_t g_idle_topstack = (uintptr_t)_ebss +
    CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE;

text:
这份 review 的结论总体是对的，而且有几处我会进一步校正优先级与表述。

## 总体裁定

| 项目 | 裁定 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| P0/P1/P2/P5 的覆盖判断 | 基本正确 | 架构复用、CP/AP 镜像边界、Beken L2-dev 封包、离线复包验证均已比通用流程更严格 |
| P3 先 L1 再 L2 的偏离 | 正确且必要 | BK7258 raw `app.bin` 不能连续写入 CP physical Flash，首次 Flash cold boot 必须经过 L2-dev `all-app.bin` |
| P4 多核后置 | 正确 | 当前 OpenVela CP L0 不启动 AP；厂商 `app1.bin` 只作锁定 payload/恢复布局 |
| `__start → up_initialize` 的说法 | review 的纠正正确 | BK7258 芯片启动应最终进入 `nx_start()`；`up_initialize()` 是 NuttX 启动流程后续调用，不应由芯片 `__start()` 手工直接替代 |
| 自定义目录边界 | 正确 | 团队的 `chips/bk7258`、`board/bk7258-devkit` 经 manifest 映射到 `vendor/beken/...` 是合理的 OpenVela 外挂模式 |
| Armino 禁止复制 | 正确 | 不复制 Armino；但可以以 NuttX 自身的 Cortex-M33 芯片目录作为结构与接口参考 |

## review 中确认的真实缺口

### 1. 缺少指定的 NuttX 参考芯片

这是真实缺口，应补入合同。

推荐不是只选一个，而是指定两个参考来源：

```text
NuttX 代码骨架参考：
  nuttx/arch/arm/src/nrf53/

OpenVela 外挂芯片接入参考：
  vendor/sifli/chips/sf32lb52/
```

`nrf53` 的价值是完整体现 Cortex-M33 芯片层最小闭环：

```text
nrf53_start.c
nrf53_irq.c
nrf53_allocateheap.c
nrf53_lowputc.c
nrf53_serial.c
nrf53_systick.c / tickless_rtc.c
nrf53_gpio.c
Make.defs
CMakeLists.txt
chip.h / hardware memory map
```

但只借鉴其文件职责、接口和 NuttX 风格，不能照搬它的 Nordic 多核、SPU、RTC 或 memory map 逻辑。

`vendor/sifli/chips/sf32lb52` 的价值是验证了 OpenVela 支持外置 vendor chip 的选择链：

```text
CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_CUSTOM=y
CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_CUSTOM_DIR="../vendor/<vendor>/chips/<chip>"
CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_CUSTOM_DIR_RELPATH=y
CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_CUSTOM_NAME="<chip>"
```

因此，BK7258 不一定需要先修改 `nuttx/arch/arm/Kconfig` 新增 `ARCH_CHIP_BK7258`。更符合当前所有权边界的路径是：

```text
configs/cp/defconfig
  → CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_CUSTOM=y
  → CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_CUSTOM_DIR="../vendor/beken/chips/bk7258"
  → CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_CUSTOM_DIR_RELPATH=y
  → CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_CUSTOM_NAME="bk7258"

vendor/beken/chips/bk7258/Kconfig
  → select ARCH_ARMV8M
  → select ARCH_CORTEXM33
  → 后续按真实能力选择 MPU/FPU/TrustZone/tickless 等
```

这正是当前 `chips/bk7258/Kconfig` 仍缺失的正式接入机制。

### 2. 文件级交付清单缺失

正确，且不仅是文档问题；它会直接影响 T5 的可验收性。

CP L1 最小文件清单应明确为：

```text
chips/bk7258/
├── include/
│   ├── chip.h                 # 芯片标识、CPU/能力选择入口
│   ├── bk7258_memorymap.h     # 已冻结的 memory/peripheral base
│   └── bk7258_irq.h           # NuttX IRQ 编号与 ICU 映射
├── bk7258_start.c             # __start、.data/.bss、VTOR、nx_start
├── bk7258_clock.c             # 仅已验证的 clock/reset gate
├── bk7258_allocateheap.c      # 已批准 SRAM 的 heap 边界
├── bk7258_irq.c               # ICU/NVIC attach/enable/disable/priority
├── bk7258_lowputc.c           # polling UART TX marker
├── bk7258_uart.c              # 后续 /dev/console、RX、IRQ
├── bk7258_timer.c             # 已批准的 arch_alarm/timer 下半部
├── bk7258_gpio.c              # pinmux/GPIO 控制器能力
├── Kconfig
├── Make.defs
└── CMakeLists.txt

board/bk7258-devkit/
├── include/board.h            # 板级 pins、console、LED/button 常量
├── scripts/flash.ld           # 仅在安全域/SRAM 所有权冻结后创建
├── src/bk7258_boardinit.c     # board 初始化钩子
├── src/bk7258_bringup.c       # 后续 LED/buttons/I2C/SPI 等板级注册
├── configs/cp/defconfig
└── configs/ap/defconfig       # 后置、明确 blocked
```

这里要修正 review 中一个小表述：**UART console 的核心注册不应默认归 `board_bringup.c`。**

在 NuttX ARM 典型模式中：

```text
早期输出      → chip lowputc / up_putc
串口控制台    → chip serial driver / arm_earlyserialinit / arm_serialinit
板级 bringup  → LED、按键、I2C、SPI、外设具体实例
```

板级代码可参与 pinmux 或 console policy，但不能把 chip UART driver/VFS 注册责任全部推给 `board_bringup.c`。

### 3. BK7258 芯片选择链为空占位

这是当前最重要的工程缺口之一，review 判断正确。

当前 `configs/cp/defconfig` 只有组件身份，不足以让 NuttX 进入 ARMv8-M/Cortex-M33、custom chip 或真实 RAM/linker 选择。

在写任何 CPU0 BSP 之前，合同需要明确：

```text
BK7258 CP 使用 CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_CUSTOM 的 vendor 外挂机制；
不是暂时伪装为 nrf53、stm32h5、mps 或其他芯片。
```

实际 defconfig 要等 SRAM/安全域冻结后再补齐，但最终至少要有：

```text
CONFIG_ARCH_ARM=y
CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_CUSTOM=y
CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_CUSTOM_DIR="../vendor/beken/chips/bk7258"
CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_CUSTOM_DIR_RELPATH=y
CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_CUSTOM_NAME="bk7258"
CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD_CUSTOM=y
CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD_CUSTOM_DIR="../vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-devkit"
CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD_CUSTOM_DIR_RELPATH=y
CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD_CUSTOM_NAME="bk7258-devkit"
CONFIG_ARCH_CORTEXM33=y        # 由 BK7258 custom-chip Kconfig 选择更合适
```

RAM、FPU、CMSE、MPU、timer、console 等不能现在猜填。

### 4. MTD / Flash 验证缺失

这是“需要明确边界”，但不是 L0 的启动硬缺口。

当前 L0 已有：

```text
Flash XIP / raw app.bin
  → linear CRC package
  → Bootloader handoff
  → NuttX 从 Flash 执行
```

因此，`nsh>` 本身已经间接证明 CPU0 能从其 CP Flash image 执行；不需要先实现 MTD 才能进入 NSH。

但确实应明确写下：

```text
L0：
  不实现 NuttX MTD、可写 Flash、文件系统 mount 或分区管理。

P2 / 后续存储阶段：
  再实现只读/可写 MTD、/dev/mtd*、分区访问与 mount 冒烟。
```

这样避免把“厂商 packaging JSON 冻结分区”误解为“NuttX 已具备 Flash 驱动”。

### 5. syslog / printf 规范缺失

真实缺口，建议在 CP 合同里加一条最小策略：

```text
__start 到 scheduler 前：
 只允许 polling up_putc()/lowputc()；
  不依赖 malloc、锁、syslog daemon 或 UART IRQ。

nx_start() 后：
  使用 NuttX syslog 作为默认诊断通道；
  ERROR：启动失败、CRC/内存/IRQ 错误；
  WARN：降级、未启用能力；
  INFO：阶段 marker、版本、已验证的时钟/内存摘要。

禁止：
  输出 broker 凭据、工具参数、敏感企业内容、绝对本机路径。
```

这不需要现在写 UART driver，但应先约定，避免 startup/debug 日志随后散落为裸 `printf()`。

### 6. 分区表单一来源

review 方向正确，但应补一个重要限定：

```text
当前 L0：
  packaging/profiles/bk7258-devkit-l0-vendor-ap.json
  + 锁定的 vendor bk_package.json / bk_ota_partitions.json
  是 L2 package 的唯一来源。

不创建：
  board partition_table.c
  NuttX MTD partition table
```

未来 AP 接管后不能直接复用当前 L0 profile，因为它锁定了厂商 `app1.bin` 的 SHA-256。即使 physical layout 不变，也必须创建一个新的 profile，例如：

```text
bk7258-devkit-system-openvela-ap.json
```

它应引用新的 OpenVela `app1.bin` 输入身份，而不是篡改 L0 profile。

## 构建命令问题：review 说得对，还需再修正一处

实际脚本确认支持：

```bash
./build.sh <board-config> --cmake -b <cmake_binary_dir> -j8
```

但组件规范当前写的是：

```bash
./build.sh board/bk7258-devkit/configs/cp --cmake ...
```

这在团队工作树中看似存在；但仓库规则要求从父级 OpenVela workspace 构建，而那里应该走 manifest 映射后的路径：

```bash
cd /home/czp/openvela_contest

./build.sh \
  vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-devkit/configs/cp \
  --cmake \
  -b cmake_out/bk7258-devkit_cp \
  -j8
```

不过这仍是**目标命令**，不是当前可执行命令，因为 custom chip 选择链、linker、startup 和完整 defconfig 尚未实现。文档应把它标记为“完成 T5 后的命令”，不能暗示现在能构建。

## 对 review 的最终结论

四项“有意偏离”都成立，不建议回退：

1. `vendor/beken/chips` / `vendor/beken/boards` 外挂布局正确；
2. 禁止复制 Armino 与借鉴 NuttX 自身参考目录不冲突；
3. BK7258 L2-dev 必须早于 Flash cold boot，raw bin 直接写 CP Flash 被正确否决；
4. 受控 SDK 子步骤 + 字节级 no-change reconstruction 比直接跑厂商 `post_package()/ota_pack()` 更适合当前 L0。

六项缺口中：

| review 项 | 处理建议 |
|---|---|
| NuttX 参考芯片 | 立即补：`nrf53` 作为 Cortex-M33 文件骨架参考，`sf32lb52` 作为 custom-chip 接入参考 |
| 文件级清单 | 立即补到 CPU0 合同 |
| chip 选择链 | 立即补到合同和 T5 前置条件；采用 `ARCH_CHIP_CUSTOM` |
| MTD | 明确后置，不把它变成 L0 阻塞 |
| 日志策略 | 立即补最小分级约定 |
| 分区单一来源 | 立即补：L0 profile + locked JSON 是唯一 L2 来源；未来 AP 采用新 profile |
| 构建命令 | 立即修正为 manifest 映射后的 `vendor/beken/...` 路径，并注明当前不可执行 |

最后还有一个文档管理问题：组件镜像规范中的 T1–T4 已完成，但总 bring-up 规划中的 T1–T12 是另一套宏观硬件任务，仍未关闭。两者不要按同名编号相互映射；下一次整理时应在总规划中明确引用组件规范的完成状态，而不是把总规划任务误标完成。

当前 CPU0 BSP 继续保持暂停是正确的。下一次实际修改应是一次**纯文档/合同修订**，补上面七项；之后再选择“获取受控启动资料”或“可恢复最小真机探针”来解除 SRAM/安全域阻塞。

## BK7258 应按 MPS 落地的核心形态
